title: Route cancel particles through frame phases
summary: Cancelation WebGL particles now use the sampled cancel-collapse visual motif phase from EquationMotionFrame instead of recomputing phase progress in the controller.

sourceRefs.summary: Routes cancel particle progress through frame visual motif phase data and writes rendered phase metadata onto the particle canvas.
Asserts cancelation particles expose cancel-collapse raw and eased phase progress while scrubbing.
